description: ITP workflow enforcement: PreToolUse guards for Bash, file edits, Read, WebFetch and AskUserQuestion; post-edit lint, type-check and docs reminders; Stop-time cleanup and lint.

hooks.description: Rewrites each Bash command to read stdin from /dev/null, so subprocesses it spawns cannot contend for the terminal and suspend the session.
Runs the 24 itp-hooks Bash guards listed in BASH_GUARD_REGISTRY in one bun process; the first deny wins and each guard fails open. Escape tokens are in each guard's registry entry.

Runs 11 Write/Edit guards in one process, first deny or ask wins: version, shell-script-safety, skill-plugin-root, typescript-version, hoisted-deps, mise-hygiene, pyi-stub, native-binary, gpu-optimization, file-size, vale-claude-md.
Blocks a Write/Edit that would put a live credential on disk (Telegram bot token, Pushover key, literal in a secret-manager command). Escape: SECRET-SCAN-OK: <10+ char reason>.
Warns, without blocking, when Read targets a file over 2000 lines without offset or limit.
Denies every built-in WebFetch call and points to the curl, agent-reach, WebSearch fallback chain. No escape token.
Denies an AskUserQuestion option that names a PR without its author and whether your review was requested, and supplies the exact annotation to append. Fails open.
Denies an AskUserQuestion whose option label or description contains a line break, which Claude Code renders as U+FFFD (anthropics/claude-code#88836). Escape: ASK-OPTION-NEWLINE-OK.
Denies writing a shell script that contains a broad kill/pkill/killall or a pkill option placed after its pattern. Escapes: BROAD-PROCESS-SIGNAL-OK or PKILL-OPTION-ORDER-OK with a reason.
Wraps known long-running Bash commands in pueue and injects OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN for 1Password; must stay the last PreToolUse entry (anthropics/claude-code#15897). Opt out: # PUEUE-SKIP.
Reminds, without blocking, to use the full Pushover budget (message 1024, title 250, url 512 chars, one image) when code sends a Pushover message. Escape: PUSHOVER-BUDGET-OK.
Reminds, without blocking, when an edited docs or config file contains a third-party email address or phone number; values are redacted. Escape: PII-SCAN-OK in the file.
Reminds when an edited Markdown file has a table that will not render (unescaped |, column-count mismatch, 4-space indent, stray alignment row). Escape: MD-TABLE-OK.

Runs 12 post-edit checks in parallel and merges their context: leakage-taxonomy, ty, tsc, oxlint, biome, vale-claude-md, memory-efficiency, ssot-principles, claude-md-size-budget, python-preference, typescript-upgrade, markdown-hard-wrap.
Reminds when an edit adds an invented display fallback such as "Unknown" or "N/A" (${x:-Unknown}, ?? "N/A", .get(k, "Unknown")). Escape: INVENTED-FALLBACK-OK.
Reminds when a pipefail shell-script edit adds a pipe into an early-exiting reader (head, grep -q, sed q, awk exit) that can fail with 141. Escapes: SIGPIPE-OK, SHELL-SAFETY-OK.
Reminds when a Bash command wrote net-new hard-wrapped prose into a Markdown file; repair with gfm-unwrap.ts. Escape: MD-HARD-WRAP-OK as an HTML comment in the file.
Runs the four Stop hooks in sequence (subprocess-cleanup, error-summary, ty-check, markdown-lint), each time-boxed and crash-isolated.
Prints a one-line review-round gate status each turn, because Bash PreToolUse output never reaches the model. Never blocks.
